name: mongolian-stt-asr-nemotron-v13m
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b (config.json max_position_embeddings 5000). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Cache-Aware FastConformer streaming encoder, 24 layers, 8 attention heads with sliding_window 57 frames, d_model 1024, plus an RNNT decoder (decoder_hidden_size 640) with prompt conditioning (default_prompt_id=11 for Mongolian). Read from the base nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b config.json, which this repo does not re-publish (its config.json is 404; it ships .nemo + GGUF).
notes: ADDED 2026-10-31. A Mongolian (Khalkha) fine-tune of nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b, same Cache-Aware FastConformer+RNNT config (24 layers, d_model 1024, read from the base config.json - this repo publishes no config, only .nemo and GGUF), 0.6B. Card prints a base row in the same 253-segment table: CER 13.16% vs 19.91% and WER 30.13% vs 41.57%, lower-is-better. Caveats recorded on the rows: the base row is labelled only 'Суурь (fine-tune хийхээс өмнө)' (base, before fine-tuning), the numbers are on the author's own 253-segment set, and the card discloses 55.7% overlap between five recordings and the v9-v12 training data. Ships GGUF Q8 only (no safetensors); param count from the card/base, not the safetensors index. Licence CC-BY-NC-4.0 (non-commercial, inherited from unlicensed training corpora), repo created 2026-09-02.

benchmarks.name: Mongolian held-out CER (253 segments)
benchmarks.config: Card table '| Хувилбар | CER | WER |' under 'Хувилбар хоорондын ахиц (253 сегмент)': 'Суурь (fine-tune хийхээс өмнө)' (base, before fine-tuning) 19.91% vs 'v13' 13.16%. Lower is better. 253 segments / 60.1 min mixed domain.

benchmarks.name: Mongolian held-out WER (253 segments)
benchmarks.config: Same table, WER 41.57% base vs 30.13% v13. Lower is better.

benchmarks.name: Mongolian held-out CER (112-line clean set, GGUF Q8)
benchmarks.config: Card table under 'Үндсэн үзүүлэлт', realworld_eval_clean 112 lines: 'GGUF Q8 (энэ загвар)' 15.03% CER / 37.07% WER. UNPAIRED - no base row on this set. The card discloses that 141 lines from five recordings overlapped v9-v12 training (55.7% of the real-world set) and this 112-line set is the de-contaminated one; it still warns the 253-segment numbers may be optimistic. Lower is better.
